description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the SkillDao class, which manages Skill entities in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It tests methods like retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching skills, as well as counting search results.

classes.name: SkillDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the SkillDao methods including CRUD operations and search functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates SkillDao, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a skill by ID and verifies its name and description.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple skills by IDs and verifies the number of deleted items.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills using default search filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new skill, then verifies its properties.

methods.name: testEditSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing skill and verifies the updated properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of skills matching search criteria.
